class.name: SourcePPBSP
class.brief_description: Loads Source BSP brush geometry into [HalfEdgeMesh] data.
class.description: [SourcePPBSP] exposes a first-cut wrapper over SourcePP's BSP reader for Source engine maps. It currently focuses on brush-model surface extraction for later import work: it can open a BSP, list the discovered materials, build a [HalfEdgeMesh] for one brush model, and return the face-to-material ID map aligned with that generated mesh. Displacement surfaces are skipped for now. Returned vertices are converted from Source inches and axes into Godot meters and orientation.

method.name: close
method.description: Releases the currently loaded BSP and all cached parsed data.

method.name: create_halfedge_mesh
method.description: Builds a [HalfEdgeMesh] for the requested BSP brush model. Model [code]0[/code] is the world brush model in standard Source BSP files. Faces with displacement data are ignored. Use [method get_face_material_ids] to map the resulting mesh faces back to [method get_material_paths].

method.name: get_face_material_ids
method.description: Returns one material ID per face in the mesh produced by [method create_halfedge_mesh] for the same [param model_index]. Each ID indexes [method get_material_paths]. Faces without a resolved material return [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_material_paths
method.description: Returns the unique BSP material paths referenced by the currently loaded map. Face material IDs index this array.

method.name: get_model_count
method.description: Returns the number of brush models stored in the BSP.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens a BSP file from disk and caches the brush-model geometry, texture info, and material table needed for mesh extraction.
